parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistFetcherTests.swift`. The two methods — `fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnURLError` (line 65) and `fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnCancellationError` (line 103) — are structurally similar (Jaccard 0.73) because they test analogous error-handling paths, but they intentionally exercise distinct error types (`URLError` vs. `CancellationError`).
